bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · sharp reversal from a record
bias.zh: 上升趋势受压 · 纪录高点后急跌

read.en: Lumentum fell 9.8% on Oct 12 to $995.41 on heavier volume, a sharp reversal from Friday's record high of $1,143. It dropped below its 5 and 10-day averages ($1,056–1,078) but stays above the rising 30-day ($961), 100-day ($876) and 200-day ($767). Parabolic SAR flipped bearish, the MACD histogram has fallen from 18 to 3 so a bearish cross is close, and RSI is 51.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月12日放量下跌 9.8%，收于 $995.41，较上周五 $1,143 的纪录高点急速反转。股价跌破 5 日和 10 日均线（$1,056–1,078），但仍高于上行的 30 日（$961）、100 日（$876）和 200 日均线（$767）。抛物线 SAR 转空，MACD 柱体由 18 降至 3，接近死叉，RSI 为 51。

read.en: Both supports from the last read broke: $1,048 and the $1,007 shelf tested four times in September (intraday low $980). The 30-day average at $961 is the next test, then $881 (Sep 28 low) and $832. Resistance is now $1,007, then the 5 and 10-day averages near $1,056–1,078 and the $1,143 record.
read.zh: 上次解读中的两个支撑均已失守：$1,048 及 9月四次测试的 $1,007 平台（盘中低点 $980）。下一测试为 $961 的 30 日均线，其次 $881（9月28日低点）和 $832。阻力现为 $1,007，其次约 $1,056–1,078 的 5 日和 10 日均线，以及 $1,143 纪录高点。
